scenes.name: a menu that closes
scenes.note: a click: three bars become an ✕, and again

scenes.name: play and pause
scenes.note: a click: the triangle splits into the two bars

scenes.name: a switch
scenes.note: a click: the knob slides and the track turns green

scenes.name: a button you press
scenes.note: press and hold: it sinks; let go: it comes back

scenes.name: a card that lifts
scenes.note: the pointer over it: it lifts; off it: it settles

scenes.name: a line the page draws
scenes.note: scroll the page: the line is drawn as the page passes it

scenes.name: throw the ball
scenes.note: take it and throw it: it flies under gravity, bounces off the floor and the sides, and goes home to its bounce

scenes.name: swing the lantern
scenes.note: take it and pull it aside: let go and it swings back as a pendulum of its own length

scenes.name: poke the jelly
scenes.note: take it and pull: let go and it springs back, overshooting, while it wobbles on

scenes.name: from Lottie
scenes.note: a Lottie file of four layers (lottie-sample.json), read by player/lottie.js: every frame drawn as exact paths and kept as keys where a straight blend cannot stand in

scenes.name: a spinner from Lottie
scenes.note: eight dots on a turning parent, each pulsing and fading a step behind the last (lottie-spinner.json): shapes that only move and fade, kept as one outline and a transform each

scenes.name: a blob from Lottie
scenes.note: a six-cornered outline breathing between round and a hexagon while its colour changes, inside a turning ring and a dot riding it (lottie-blob.json)
